flags: OHV (flag, reviewer decides): the home page markets 'easy trail access to 700+ miles of motorized trails just behind BCC' with staff who will 'gladly take you along' - a private park marketing motorized trails starting at the campground. It also sells ordinary summer nights to RVs and runs as a Sturgis Rally camp; reads as a general/rally campground with an OHV side, but the rule's 'private parks that market ATV trails starting at the campground' wording fits.

PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest RV electric night $30 (30-amp FHU), 50-amp FHU $40; summer peak $60 all-weather pull-through. Rally rate not the test. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Mount Rushmore 52 km).
LONG-STAY: weekly/monthly specials 'upon Request' only; nightly is the headline product - transient.

WEBSITE: keep https://bulldogcreek.com/ (Google's bulldogcreekcampground.com redirects there) and the RoverPass line - the listing is maintained by the operator (Last Updated 11/19/2026) and is the site's BOOK NOW target.
